title: COVID-19 therapeutics supply-chain optimisation (NSF EAGER #2028612)
description:
Minimum-cost network-flow model for distributing COVID-19 therapeutics across Harris County, Texas, with penalties on unmet demand so that an under-supplied instance answers who goes short, and where rather than simply reporting infeasibility.

Includes a reconstruction of the published scenarios. The paper's parameter file was not preserved; demand was recovered exactly from the project's own population table (3,270,360 people across ZIPs 77002-77099, 20% elderly target = 654,072, both matching the paper to the digit), and the two unrecorded parameters were fitted against the published results. The reconstruction reproduces all three published penalty figures within 0.4%. One published figure, a 32% service level, is shown to be arithmetically incompatible with the others and is reported as such rather than fitted around.

Funded by the National Science Foundation under EAGER award #2028612, "AI-Enabled Optimization of the COVID-19 Therapeutics Supply Chain to Support Community Public Health".
